C0843.title: Microsoft Report: AI Boosts Phishing Attack Efficiency by 4.5 Times
C0843.summary: CBI News reported on October 17, 2025 that Microsoft's annual Digital Defense Report said AI-generated phishing emails had a 54% click-through rate, compared with 12% for traditional non-AI phishing emails, making users about 4.5 times more likely to click malicious links or files. The report also said AI helps criminals write more localized and targeted phishing lures.

references.title: Microsoft Says AI Boosts Phishing Attack Efficiency by 4.5 Times, Profits Could Increase 50-Fold
